name: Kentucky
dueDateNotes: Kentucky follows the federal schedule: April 15, June 15, September 15, and January 15.
selfEmploymentNotes: Kentucky taxes your federal AGI at a flat 3.5% (2026) after a $3,360 standard deduction. Kentucky applies one standard deduction per return, so joint filers should confirm their exact figure.
uniqueFacts: Kentucky has a flat 3.5% income tax for 2026, down from 4% two years earlier.
Kentucky's 2026 standard deduction is $3,360, subtracted before the flat rate applies.
Kentucky only requires estimated payments if your estimated tax after withholding is more than $500.
